question_text:
91. Which of the following statements is/are right ?
(a) The stranger did not seem to be badly hurt.
(b) Mini-Moris went past the stranger and then stopped.

92. Which of the following statements is/are correct ?
(1) There was snowfall, and a ditch along the road so Bill was driving very carefully.
(2) Because of snow, he was driving very slowly.
(3) It was night time, so there was no traffic on the road, so Bill was driving in a carefree manner.
(4) It was the dead of night, so Bill was feeling drowsy while driving.
option_a: There was snowfall, and a ditch along the road so Bill was driving very carefully.
option_b: Because of snow, he was driving very slowly.
option_c: It was night time, so there was no traffic on the road, so Bill was driving in a carefree manner.
option_d: It was the dead of night, so Bill was feeling drowsy while driving.

question_text:
93. '.... he loomed up in front of ....'
The underlined phrase means the same as :
(1) fell down
(2) appeared
(3) drove up
(4) looked up

94. '.... brought the Mini-Moris gradually to a stop'.
The underlined is opposite in meaning to _________.
(1) generally
(2) usually
(3) suddenly
(4) mainly

95. Pat gave a little gasp and I braked at once.
The underlined is a/an _________.
(1) Pronoun
(2) Preposition
(3) Conjunction
(4) Interjection

96. It was then that I saw the car .
Identify the underlined clause.
(1) Principal
(2) Noun
(3) Adjective
(4) Adverb

97. Study the following statements :
(a) Pat is bold and compassionate.
(b) Bill is protective of Pat and not timid
(c) A badly hit car was parked by the side walk.
(1) (a) is right but (b) and (c) are wrong.
(2) (b) is right but (a) and (c) are wrong.
(3) (a) and (b) are right but (c) is wrong.
(4) (b) and (c) are right but (a) is wrong.
option_a: (a) is right but (b) and (c) are wrong.
option_b: (b) is right but (a) and (c) are wrong.
option_c: (a) and (b) are right but (c) is wrong.
option_d: (b) and (c) are right but (a) is wrong.

question_text:
98. Bill was travelling with :
(1) his brother
(2) his sister
(3) a friend
(4) a stranger

99. Which of the following statements is not correct ?
After slowing down the car, Bill hesitated as :
(1) it was a dark spot, so it might be a case of robbery.
(2) only Pat, a woman was sitting beside him.
(3) both (1) and (2)
(4) in the cold, the car may not start again.
option_a: it was a dark spot, so it might be a case of robbery.
option_b: only Pat, a woman was sitting beside him.
option_d: in the cold, the car may not start again.

question_text:
100. Study the following statements :
(a) The Bishop asked Robin Hood the purpose of his visit.
(b) Robin Hood pretended to be a musician.
(1) (a) is right and (b) is wrong.
(2) (b) is right and (a) is wrong.
(3) Both (a) and (b) are right.
(4) Both (a) and (b) are wrong.

101. What was going to take place in the church ?
(1) a wedding
(2) a Sunday sermon
(3) a baptism
(4) a funeral service

102. 'I prithee now ...'
The expression means :
(1) I prevent you.
(2) I warn you.
(3) I request you.
(4) I order you.

103. Robin Hood met the Bishop :
(1) in the churchyard
(2) in the church
(3) at his residence
(4) in the market

104. Which one of the following statements is incorrect ?
(1) The bridegroom was rich and handsome.
(2) He was old and dull looking.
(3) The bride was young and beautiful.
(4) She was not eagerly waiting for the ceremony.
option_a: The bridegroom was rich and handsome.
option_b: He was old and dull looking.
option_c: The bride was young and beautiful.
option_d: She was not eagerly waiting for the ceremony.

question_text:
105. Which literary device has been used in the expression - 'Did shine like glistening gold' ?
(1) Simile
(2) Metaphor
(3) Personification
(4) Hyperbole

106. A child does not write a paragraph on her own even after brainstorming the topic. However, she is able to write it under adult or peer guidance. This guidance is called __________.
(1) Scaffolding
(2) Peer teaching
(3) Peer counselling
(4) Team teaching

107. ___________ is a type of learning in which a child has to use higher-order mental processes such as intelligence or reasoning.
(1) Verbal learning
(2) Concept learning
(3) Motor skills learning
(4) Structure learning

108. You as a teacher appreciate a child for her 'overall language use', though some of the words are misspelt by her. You are here using ___________ approach in your class.
(1) Whole language
(2) Communicative
(3) Constructivist
(4) Structural

109. You are a Hindi speaking teacher, but you get posted in a primary school which is in the area of Punjab. Since you do not know the local language of that area, you should :
(1) immediately apply for the transfer to a Hindi speaking area.
(2) use the child's language as a resource and start teaching.
(3) communicate in English
(4) motivate the community to learn Hindi.
option_a: immediately apply for the transfer to a Hindi speaking area.
option_b: use the child's language as a resource and start teaching.
option_d: motivate the community to learn Hindi.

question_text:
110. ___________ comprehension is the skill of reading a piece of text closely or intensely for the purpose of extracting specific information from the text.
(1) Global
(2) Local
(3) Inferential
(4) Evaluative

111. The purpose of diagnostic test in language learning is to :
(1) Plan and prepare questions for summative assessment.
(2) Inform the parents in the PTMs and ask them to pay attention.
(3) Know the gaps in learner's understanding and take remedial steps.
(4) Use the findings in the progress report of students.
option_a: Plan and prepare questions for summative assessment.
option_b: Inform the parents in the PTMs and ask them to pay attention.
option_c: Know the gaps in learner's understanding and take remedial steps.
option_d: Use the findings in the progress report of students.

question_text:
112. Which one of the following is a correct statement about a textbook ?
(1) A textbook is the final thing for the teacher and the student.
(2) It helps to achieve the objectives laid down in the curriculum.
(3) It is a planning of educational activities for the session.
(4) A textbook is irreplaceable.
option_a: A textbook is the final thing for the teacher and the student.
option_b: It helps to achieve the objectives laid down in the curriculum.
option_c: It is a planning of educational activities for the session.

question_text:
113. Which of the following classroom practices helps a teacher to develop oral language among the students ?
(1) Chorus reading of the text with the teacher.
(2) Chorus recitation of the poem after memorising it.
(3) Participating in role-plays.
(4) Practicing the correct pronunciation of new or unfamiliar words.
option_a: Chorus reading of the text with the teacher.
option_b: Chorus recitation of the poem after memorising it.
option_d: Practicing the correct pronunciation of new or unfamiliar words.

question_text:
114. When we say 'Language is arbitrary', we mean to say that :
(1) there is an inherent relation between the words of a language and their meaning.
(2) the relation between words and their meaning is based on a valid reason and not on chance.
(3) there is no inherent relation between the words of a language and their meaning.
(4) Language follows prefixed principles.
option_a: there is an inherent relation between the words of a language and their meaning.
option_b: the relation between words and their meaning is based on a valid reason and not on chance.
option_c: there is no inherent relation between the words of a language and their meaning.

question_text:
115. Deductive approach of teaching grammar advocates that, we should ___________ first.
(1) present examples
(2) present rules
(3) present genuine communication
(4) provide practice through drills

116. ___________ is a way of estimating or guessing beyond the facts.
(1) Explanation
(2) Analysis
(3) Inference
(4) Extrapolation

117. A language teacher must promote learners for free writing, as the key benefit of free writing is that :
(1) it encourages learners to write fluently and creatively.
(2) gives the freedom to write or not.
(3) does not make them feel that they have to write much or be totally accurate.
(4) can incorporate features of written language from their first language.
option_a: it encourages learners to write fluently and creatively.
option_b: gives the freedom to write or not.
option_c: does not make them feel that they have to write much or be totally accurate.
option_d: can incorporate features of written language from their first language.

question_text:
118. As a teacher of class V you ask the students to read the text thoroughly. Then you ask them to answer the questions with reference to the context (RTC). In this process, you are encouraging students for ____________.
(1) extensive reading
(2) scanning
(3) skimming
(4) intensive reading

119. Language acquisition occurs only when the __________.
(1) child is taught the rules of grammar
(2) child is given practice in translation
(3) child is given opportunity to read
(4) child has exposure to the language
option_a: child is taught the rules of grammar
option_b: child is given practice in translation
option_c: child is given opportunity to read
option_d: child has exposure to the language
